lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: Hi Maria, it's M.G. from FinTechCard. Quick one.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: I noticed on Companies House you opened a second store on Deansgate in {{month:maria_store}}. Who's approving card spend across both stores now?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Well, my bookkeeper does, but honestly she's drowning. Receipts pile up, and she spends about six hours a week reconciling the two stores.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: So your bookkeeper is drowning in receipts from both stores.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: We already have a corporate Visa from our bank, though.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: So you already have a corporate Visa from your bank.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Yeah, but the controls are a mess. Last quarter a £1,200 charge sat there for two weeks and nobody could say whose it was.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: Got it: seeing who spent what is the broken thing, not the card. Two 20-minute slots: Tuesday 10:00 or Wednesday 10:30. Which works to walk through it with your bookkeeper?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Wednesday 10:30.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: [Calendar invite "Maria + bookkeeper · Two Pines demo" sent during the call]

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Got it. I'll forward it to my bookkeeper.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: Perfect. Talk Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Tom — quick question, you on Brex?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yeah, we are. Why?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Well, our per-team budgets are way better than Brex's — way more granular controls and the SSO is cleaner.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: OK, well, we just rolled out Brex three months ago. Not changing.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Sure, but our AWS-spend visibility is actually real-time, not 30-day lagged like Brex.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Look, I have to go. Send me an email if you want.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: Hi Emma — saw Brightline's latest filing, headcount up 18% this year. How is procurement handling card-tagging at that scale?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Badly. Finance tags four hundred transactions a month by hand. Xero doesn't see the job numbers.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: So you've got 400 manual tags landing on finance every month because Xero can't read job numbers off the card transactions — that's the bottleneck.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Exactly. The last vendor promised Xero line-level export, and it broke.

lines.speaker: M.G.
lines.text: Fair. Could I get 20 minutes with you and your Xero admin together — Tuesday 14:00 or Thursday 11:30 — to show you the actual export against a real Xero file?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Thursday 11:30. I'll bring our Xero admin.

lines.speaker: L.D.
lines.text: Saw your Series B in {{month:tom_series_b}} — congrats. How are you handling per-employee card issuance for the six engineers you're hiring?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We already use Brex. We're fine.

lines.speaker: L.D.
lines.text: So you already use Brex, and the card side is fine.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yeah. Finance does moan about the FX on our AWS bill, but that's it.

lines.speaker: L.D.
lines.text: What does the FX on AWS and your SaaS subscriptions cost you in a month?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Honestly, no idea. Probably a lot.

lines.speaker: L.D.
lines.text: Can I show you the FX cost against Brex on last month's spend? 20 minutes, Tuesday at 11:00 or Thursday at 14:00?

lines.speaker: L.D.
lines.text: [Calendar invite "Tom + L.D. · FX cost vs Brex" sent during the call]

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Tuesday 11. Send it.

lines.speaker: P.B.
lines.text: Hi, this is P. calling from FinTechCard. Do you have a moment to talk about your corporate spending?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: No.
Call ended.
